fact: The ENTICS 2024 household survey by ARTP for ANSD, collected 5 September to 4 October 2024, found 43.8% of Dakar households with a home internet connection, 16.3% in other urban areas and about 3% in rural areas.
title: Presque 44 % des ménages de Dakar ont une connexion Internet à domicile, seulement 3 % en disposent en milieu rural, selon l'ANSD
